label: Shrine combat resolves the surface threat

text.short: Rusk's fall resolves the surface threat at the shrine.
text.summary: Ending combat at the shrine records that the surface bandit threat has been broken, and may trigger a surface-only resolution event.
text.full: When the shrine fight ends, the most immediate answer to the Grey Road violence has either been broken or escaped. What remains is the harder question: whether the surface threat was the whole truth.
text.sms: The shrine fight ends. Now you must decide what it means.
text.recap: The shrine combat resolved the surface threat.

effects.source_knowledge_summary: The surface threat at the shrine was broken, but its meaning still had to be decided.

feedback.sms: A resolution choice opens at the shrine.
feedback.summary: Because no deeper route was unlocked, the campaign presents a surface-resolution choice now.
The shrine fight changed the campaign state and may now force an interpretation.
